# Startup Valuation Engine

> Open-source (MIT) Python library and MCP server implementing 80+ formulas from the Startup Valuation textbook by Simon Mak (Valuation in Practice Series, Ascent Partners). 14 read-only, deterministic MCP tools cover pre-revenue methods (Scorecard, Berkus, Risk-Factor Summation, VC Method), probability and expected value, DCF and terminal value, CAPM/WACC, Black-Scholes and binomial options, comparables, SaaS, marketplace, fintech, biotech rNPV, hardware, international adjustments, stakeholder equity, SAFE conversion and token valuation.

## Connect

- Hosted MCP endpoint (Streamable HTTP, no API key): https://startup-valuation.simonmak.com/api
- Local stdio server: `uvx --from startup-valuation startup-valuation-mcp` or `pip install 'startup-valuation[mcp]' && startup-valuation-mcp`
- Official MCP Registry name: `io.github.simonplmak-cloud/startup-valuation`
- Glama listing: https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/simonplmak-cloud/startup-valuation
- Context7 library ID: `/simonplmak-cloud/startup-valuation`

## MCP tools

All tools are pure arithmetic (no I/O), read-only and idempotent; a `method` parameter selects the formula inside each tool and results are rounded to 2 decimals.

- `valuation_core`: Scorecard, Berkus, Risk-Factor Summation, VC Method, terminal value, triangulated valuation
- `valuation_probability`: discrete and continuous expected value, joint probability, probability-weighted value, VC portfolio return, Poisson events
- `valuation_time_value`: PV, NPV, annuity PV, DCF with Gordon terminal value, compound growth
- `valuation_capm`: CAPM, startup-adjusted CAPM, portfolio beta, WACC
- `valuation_advanced`: Black-Scholes, binomial-tree options, named scenario analysis
- `valuation_comparables`: P/E, P/S, EV/EBITDA, EV/Revenue, regression-adjusted multiples
- `valuation_saas`, `valuation_marketplace`, `valuation_fintech`, `valuation_biotech`, `valuation_hardware`: sector-specific metrics and models
- `valuation_international`: purchasing-power parity, country risk premium, international CAPM
- `valuation_stakeholder`: dilution, OPM common stock, PWERM, liquidation value, M&A synergy, employee options, vesting
- `valuation_emerging`: SAFE conversion, token valuation (equation of exchange, NVT), ESG adjustments, Metcalfe network value, data-moat value
